subtitle: Lesson 48 · PostgreSQL Deep Dive for T-SQL Developers

eyebrow: PostgreSQL leans on FUNCTION, not PROCEDURE
caption: Even logic you'd write as a T-SQL stored procedure becomes a FUNCTION here.
T-SQL has no equivalent -- its procedure body isn't a quoted string at all.

eyebrow: Block structure: closer to PL/SQL than T-SQL
caption: DECLARE / BEGIN / EXCEPTION / END -- modeled on Oracle, not T-SQL's batches.

eyebrow: Calling it: an expression, not EXEC
caption: Called inside SELECT like any expression -- no EXEC keyword.
